header.do_not_edit: FROZEN. Never edit and never regenerate this file. It is the old trigger's output: the reference the new trigger's version 1 writer (STAGE_FORMAT_V2 off) must match byte for byte (outcome-ask.test.ts), and the stage the plugin from that commit is tested against (test_outcome_ask.py, the roll section). If a test against it fails, the writer changed, not the fixture. Delete it together with the version 1 writer, never update it.
